response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile full-stack engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and embedded systems, meeting the baseline years-of-experience and language requirements. However, his resume shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core domain of this role. His career trajectory (senior/staff roles at mostly small-to-mid-size companies, with one high-scale stint at Dunnhumby) does not demonstrate the Principal/IC6-level ownership of cross-team platforms, statistical rigor, or rollout-risk management this position demands.
strengths: 15+ years of engineering experience across diverse languages and platforms, satisfying the baseline technical requirement
Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, workshops, and founding an open-source platform (GISCollective)
Some large-scale, low-latency systems experience (Dunnhumby, handling millions of requests/sec)
concerns: No evidence of experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flagging platform experience
No demonstrated background in growth engineering, telemetry systems, or statistical/bias analysis
Career history lacks clear Principal-level scope — mostly senior/staff roles at smaller companies without cross-team platform ownership at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: No telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical analysis background
Broad technical experience and years in industry
